title: Recoveries from Liable Third Parties — Travel Protection Plans
content:
Where a third party was liable for the loss, the insurer may recover what it paid on a Travel Protection Plans certificate, and the amount recovered restores the benefit it was taken from.

A recovery is applied against the payment it reverses and never against a different claim or a different policy.

A traveller who has been compensated for the same loss by the airline, the property or another supplier must say so.

A plan on which recovery from a liable third party does not apply makes no recovery at all, and the settlement stands as paid.

A recovery never reopens a decided claim: the decision stands and only the benefit consumed is restored.

## Clauses no longer in force

The clause providing that, where the traveller has been compensated by a supplier for the same loss, "the settlement is reduced by what they received rather than recovered afterwards" is **no longer in force**; what becomes of a supplier's compensation is settled on the current basis for such a declaration and not by this note. That the traveller must say so remains the case.

The clause providing that "The traveller keeps whatever the recovery exceeds, because the insurer recovers only what it actually paid." is likewise **no longer in force**; what a restoration is held to is settled on the current basis and not by this note.

The remaining clauses above stand as clauses in force, and the plan entry this note reads — whether recovery from a liable third party applies to the plan at all — is valid as scheduled.

## What a recovery touches and what it leaves alone

A recovery touches the benefit consumed on the certificate the payment was made under, and it touches nothing else. It does not move to another claim, it does not move to another policy, and it does not disturb the decision the insurer reached: that decision stands, whatever comes back afterwards.

Where the plan carries no right of recovery from a liable third party, nothing is recovered at all, and the settlement already paid stands exactly as it was paid.
